## tooltip_evaluation

`} } add_to_temp_variable = { unlock_compare = num_armies } } operators =  { faction_members } input = game:scope collection = { all_collection_elements = { set_temp_variable = { unlock_compare = 0 } tooltip_evaluation = eval hidden_trigger = {` `hidden_trigger = { tooltip_evaluation = no_eval add_political_power = 10 }` Examples - `legacy` - Previous behaviour that is similar to `eval` but a lot less predictable. Using this explicitly is very likely a bug - `no_eval` - If you have no random parts or side effects, then this will give you a slightly faster computation of the tooltip. - `eval` - Standard evalulation of the trigger. This is most likely what you need if you have a trigger that has side effects or random parts. There are three possible evaluation techniques to use when computing tooltips for hidden_triggers - The trigger uses random numbers (e.g. acts on a random state) - The trigger has a side effect (e.g. temporary variables). This might be required in the following cases: The trigger can still be evaluate when generating a tooltip. A hidden trigger, that will not be displayed in the tooltip.

作用域：`any`

```ts
"tooltip_evaluation"(value: "eval"): boolean;
"tooltip_evaluation"(value: "no_eval"): boolean;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/triggers_ncns.cwt:706](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/triggers_ncns.cwt#L706)
- [Config/triggers_ncns.cwt:733](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/triggers_ncns.cwt#L733)
